notes.title: Live Stream on Land of the Crescent
notes.notes:
Are you ready for Land of the Crescent: Games from Turkey! 

MEARTH II  plans to participate by releasing a limited time new demo that will be playable during the duration of the festival.

You can ask questions and give feedback to the developers during the live broadcast event.

At the start of the playtest a ‘demo’ button will appear on our Steam storepage. You will need to download and launch the demo version of MEARTH II  in order to participate in the Land of the Crescent playtest. We will announce the exact ending times for the playtest later. Thanks again for all your support !

Best,

ICON GAME STUDIO

notes.title: Official Reveal Trailer
notes.notes:
We are proud to share a news:

[previewyoutube=idKHWWtAekI;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]

We sincerely hope that you enjoy this small insight, and fraction of what kind of game MEARTH II is
shaping up to be.

Join the adventure of Asteria, a dramatic life story.

We opened the steam page of MEARTH II, the game we developed, don't forget to add it to your wish list.

We value and appreciate your interest and feedback! Truly, from the bottom of our hearts - thank you!

Best regards,

Aykut Akdag
ICON GAME STUDIO
